commission.source_quote: The Platform shall retain a commission of 18% of the Net Order Value.

delivery_fee.source_quote: A delivery fee of Rs. 35.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share becomes payable when delivery is confirmed. Settlement shall not occur earlier than 24 hours after confirmation.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: No tax shall be withheld at source under this agreement.
